scope: Mains 4 exact claim: July 1991 industrial policy reduced licensing and public-sector reservations
verbatim_claim: The July 1991 industrial policy reduced licensing and public-sector reservations.
finding: SUPPORTED by directly inspected Government of India Economic Survey 1991-92 retrospective: industrial policy announced 24 July 1991; licensing abolished except 18 industries; public-sector reserved areas reduced from 17 to 8. This is a government contemporary retrospective, not direct inspection of the original signed policy PDF. A NITI digital-library catalogue identifies a 4.95 MB original policy PDF but its bytes were not downloaded in this run.

sources.details: Licensing abolished except 18 industries; public-sector reservations 17 to 8; MRTP prior approvals removed.
Statement on Industrial Policy 1991, Planning Commission, July 1991, PDF 4.95MB.
Policy transcription corroborates exceptions; not authenticated original file.

decision: NO_MANUSCRIPT_EDIT: existing bounded sentence is supported. Move only this claim's source crosswalk from OPEN_PRIMARY_POLICY_TEXT to SUPPORTED_BY_CONTEMPORARY_OFFICIAL_RETROSPECTIVE; original policy PDF remains NOT_DIRECTLY_INSPECTED. Outcomes and Telangana causal claims remain OPEN.
